follow100Note: Merchant solutions brings in $76.31 of every $100 — mostly a cut of merchants' sales — and subscription plans add $23.69. Direct costs take $51.92 and running the business takes another $31.54, leaving $16.54 of operating profit per $100. A $978M paper gain on equity investments added $34.78, and after a $22M equity-method loss and $128M of tax, Shopify kept $45.98 of every $100. Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
footerNote: The earnings release prints a condensed statement (operating income $465M, net other income including taxes of $828M, net income $1,293M); the split of that $828M into other income, the equity-method loss and the tax provision comes from the detailed statement in Shopify's Form 10-K filed the same day, less the nine-month figures in its Q3 2024 interim financial statements, as the release itself directs.
oneTimers: An $835M after-tax paper gain on equity investments: a $928M unrealized gain on equity and other investments as the value of Shopify's stakes rose. Shopify says net income excluding the impact of equity investments was $458M (non-GAAP), versus $1,293M GAAP net income. The $22M loss on its equity-method investment (Flexport) is separate and already reflected in the GAAP figure.
otherDetail: Other income of $978M in total: a $928M unrealized gain on equity and other investments as the value of Shopify's stakes rose, plus $72M of interest income, partly offset by a $22M foreign-exchange loss. The $22M equity-method loss is the separate equityM line; the rest nets to otherIncomeM of $978M.
pngFooterNote: Paper gains on equity stakes lifted net income to $1.3B.

segments.name: Subscription solutions
segments.note: The monthly plans merchants pay to run their stores on Shopify. Up 27% YoY; monthly recurring revenue reached $178M.

segments.name: Merchant solutions
segments.note: Mostly payment processing (Shopify Payments) — a cut of the sales flowing through merchants' stores — plus shipping and other merchant services. Up 33% YoY and 76% of all revenue.

Form 6-K Exhibit 99.1 — Q3 2024 interim financial statements, nine-month comparatives for the Q4 split (SEC EDGAR)

takeaways.text: Revenue rose 31% to $2.81B as GMV grew 26% to $94.5B — the seventh straight quarter of 25% or greater revenue growth excluding logistics. Merchant solutions led, up 33% to $2.15B, while subscription revenue grew 27% to $666M and monthly recurring revenue reached $178M.
takeaways.title: Growth accelerated into year-end

takeaways.text: Operating income rose 61% to $465M from $289M a year ago, as gross profit grew 27% to $1.35B while operating expenses rose only 15%. Free cash flow was $611M — 22% of revenue, the highest margin of 2024, with the margin growing sequentially each quarter of the year.
takeaways.title: Operating profit jumped 61%

takeaways.text: Net income was $1.29B, but $835M of it (after tax) was a paper gain on equity investments — a $928M unrealized gain as the value of Shopify's stakes rose. Excluding equity investments, net income was $458M, up 36% from $337M a year ago.
takeaways.title: Paper gains did the heavy lifting

verdict: Shopify's biggest quarter yet: revenue grew 31% to $2.8B and operating income jumped 61% to $465M — but $835M of the $1.3B net income was a paper gain on equity investments, so the underlying profit was $458M.
